# References

## Primary Documentation & Standards

- **The Linux Kernel Archives:** Official kernel source repository and documentation. <https://kernel.org>
- **Filesystem Hierarchy Standard (FHS 3.0):** Specification for Linux directory layout. Linux Foundation. <https://refspecs.linuxfoundation.org/FHS_3.0/fhs-3.0.html>
- **The Linux From Scratch (LFS) Project:** Gerard Beekmans et al. Step-by-step compilation manual. <https://linuxfromscratch.org>
- **UEFI Specification (v2.10):** Unified Extensible Firmware Interface Forum. <https://uefi.org/specifications>
- **Boot Loader Specification (BLS):** systemd project and FreeDesktop.org standards. <https://uapi-group.org/specifications/specs/boot_loader_specification/>
- **El Torito Bootable CD-ROM Format Specification (v1.0):** Phoenix Technologies & IBM (1995).

## Toolchains & Standard Libraries

- **GNU Compiler Collection (GCC):** Free Software Foundation. <https://gcc.gnu.org>
- **GNU Binutils:** Assembler, Linker, and Binary utilities. <https://gnu.org/software/binutils/>
- **The GNU C Library (glibc):** Reference manual and architecture documentation. <https://gnu.org/software/libc/>
- **musl-libc:** Rich Felker et al. Lightweight standards-conforming C library. <https://musl.libc.org>

## Init Systems & Process Supervisors

- **systemd System and Service Manager:** Lennart Poettering, Kay Sievers et al. <https://systemd.io>
- **OpenRC Service Manager:** Gentoo Linux and Roy Marples. <https://github.com/OpenRC/openrc>
- **s6 Supervision Suite:** Laurent Bercot (Skaaware). <https://skarnet.org/software/s6/>
- **runit Process Supervision:** Gerrit Pape. <http://smarden.org/runit/>
- **BusyBox:** The Swiss Army Knife of Embedded Linux. Denis Vlasenko et al. <https://busybox.net>

## Package Management & Solvers

- **Debian Policy Manual:** Packaging standards and guidelines. <https://debian.org/doc/debian-policy/>
- **libsolv Package Dependency Solver:** SUSE and Michael Schroeder. SAT-based dependency resolution library. <https://github.com/openSUSE/libsolv>
- **Arch Linux Packaging Standards & PKGBUILD:** ArchWiki community. <https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/PKGBUILD>
- **apk-tools:** Alpine Linux package manager. Natanael Copa et al. <https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/apk-tools>

## Security & Reproducible Builds

- **The Reproducible Builds Project:** Verifiable software supply chains. <https://reproducible-builds.org>
- **Linux Security Modules (LSM) & SELinux:** National Security Agency & Red Hat. <https://github.com/SELinuxProject>
- **AppArmor Project:** Path-based mandatory access control. <https://apparmor.net>
- **The Linux Kernel Lockdown & Secure Boot:** Matthew Garrett et al.
